plugins.name: skill-heaven
plugins.description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. Dynamic skill manager and clean-context controller for coding agents. Eliminates context bloat, preserves prompt cache, and cuts token overhead by summoning specialized SKILL.md agent capabilities on-demand for a single session without permanent installation. Supports zero-default clean launches (/skill-zero) to cut ambient tools, focused gap convergence (/skill-heaven), exploratory multi-expert capability (/skill-hell), autonomous adaptive entropy routing (/skill-ultra), and one-shot ephemeral skill summoning (/summon) from remote git repositories or gaiaskilltree.com.
